maddeler.e:
نحتشد (form VIII)
# نَحْتَشِدُ (naḥtašidu) /naħ.ta.ʃi.du/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَشَدَ (iḥtašada)
# نَحْتَشِدَ (naḥtašida) /naħ.ta.ʃi.da/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَشَدَ (iḥtašada)
# نَحْتَشِدْ (naḥtašid) /naħ.ta.ʃid/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِحْتَشَدَ (iḥtašada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
